PSP:world-series-of-poker-tournament-of-.d: World Series of Poker is a video game based on the popular gambling tournament World Series of Poker. It is succeeded by World Series of Poker: Tournament of Champions and World Series of Poker 2008: Battle for the Bracelets. It was released for the GameCube, PlayStation 2, Xbox, PlayStation Portable, and Windows. Games included in the World Series of Poker package are Omaha, Omaha hi-low split, seven-card stud, seven-card stud hi-low split, razz (seven stud lowball), and Texas hold 'em.

PS4:terraria.d: Terraria ( tə-RAIR-ee-ə) is a 2011 action-adventure video game developed and published by Re-Logic. As a sandbox game, Terraria has no set goals. After creating the player character and choosing the game's difficulty, the player is placed in a two-dimensional, procedurally generated world where they explore, fight enemies, gather resources, and craft equipment. Players beat bosses, a tougher variety of enemies, to gain access to more items, resources, and equipment.

The first BattleTech based game to be released for the Sega Genesis, it was later ported to the Super NES by Activision as MechWarrior 3050. The Super NES version was localized and published in Japan by Ask Group. The story takes place during the events of the Clan Invasion in the 3050 era.

Wii:madworld.d: MadWorld is a 2009 beat 'em up hack and slash video game developed by PlatinumGames and published by Sega for the Wii. A spiritual successor, Anarchy Reigns, was released for the Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3 in 2012.

Critically well-received, No Remorse was followed by the PC-only sequel Crusader: No Regret in 1996.

Mac:escape-from-monkey-island.d: Escape from Monkey Island is a 2000 adventure game developed and published by LucasArts.
